proposed_comments.title: Do not log virtual-key values when device resolution fails
proposed_comments.body:
### Do not log virtual-key values when device resolution fails
**Severity:** `medium`

When a key event has an unresolved device path, this trace logs its virtual-key code before checking `autoSwitchEnabled`. The source comment notes this can happen on a Surface Type Cover after KIP device re-enumeration, so with trace logging enabled key identifiers can be retained even when auto-switch is disabled. Keep the dropped-key diagnostic but omit the key value.

```suggestion
Logger::trace(L"[autosw] keydown with unresolvable device — skipped");
```
